findings.text: follow-on: the compares-with lint is delivered through the same findings list the refusal path consumes — _sandbox_reachability returns it at reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1990 and reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:879 turns any non-empty findings list into NodeValidation(ok=False) — so a model-building node that states no comparison is refused outright instead of warned, which is not the 'lint warning' plan §6 words for this check; the node's own follow_ons records the same reading and the one-line remedy (a non-fatal path in dispatch_plan.py's verdict handling) sits outside its fence, so it is disclosed rather than hidden and does not hold the node.
